description: Compute login streaks per player (gaps-and-islands). A streak is a maximal run of consecutive UTC calendar dates on which the player logged in at least once. As of @as_of_date = DATE '2025-07-06' (ignore logins after that date), return each player's longest streak, the start date of that longest streak (earliest one if tied), and the current streak: the length of the streak that includes @as_of_date, or 0 if the player did not log in on @as_of_date. Players with no logins are omitted. Output columns: player_id (INT64), longest_streak_days (INT64), longest_streak_start (DATE), current_streak_days (INT64). Sort by player_id.

login_ts.description: UTC login timestamp; several logins per day are common

edge_cases: Two logins on 2025-07-02 must count as one day, otherwise the island key breaks
Missing 2025-07-04 splits player 1's logins into streaks of 3 and 2 days
A player whose last login is before @as_of_date has current_streak_days = 0
Logins at 23:59:59 and 00:00:00 belong to different UTC dates
common_failure_modes: FM3: Applying the date-minus-ROW_NUMBER island technique without first de-duplicating to distinct dates fragments streaks on multi-login days
FM2: Deriving the date in a local timezone shifts logins near midnight and merges or splits streaks
FM7: Reporting the most recent streak as 'current' even when it ended before @as_of_date
